widgets_values:
16:9 YouTube thumbnail, strict black and white high contrast, ultra-dark minimalist background, slight vignetting (edges 15% darker than center, no texture), clean and breathable composition
USE UPLOADED PORTRAIT PHOTO AS 100% REFERENCE, restore facial features, hairstyle, outline and temperament perfectly, head-and-shoulders close-up placed on the right 45% of the canvas, 10% top and bottom margins, hard light from front-left 45° illuminates the face, creates sharp high-contrast shadows, maintain the expression and gaze direction of the uploaded portrait, facial area accounts for 60% of the subject block height, clear details no blur
Left text area occupies 55% of the canvas width, text block is vertically centered and horizontally left-aligned, maximum width ≤ 46% of the canvas, 8% canvas width negative space between text and subject, mandatory SF Pro font, base weight Semibold, highlighted keyword weight Heavy, line spacing 1.12, font size restrained (30% height of text area, no space filling)
Three-line text fixed format: your [AUTOMATIC KEYWORD MATCHED TO PORTRAIT TEMPERAMENT] → the keyword must be wrapped in a clean shadowless white rectangle with black text, no rounded corners, 2px padding / is your (pure white SF Pro Semibold) / unfair edge (pure white SF Pro Semibold)
KEYWORD MATCHING RULES: if the portrait is serious/professional → keyword = focus; if the portrait is energetic/confident → keyword = energy; if the portrait is calm/thoughtful → keyword = mindset; if the portrait is sharp/aggressive → keyword = edge; if the portrait is determined/persistent → keyword = grit; if the portrait is friendly/approachable → keyword = charm; if the portrait is creative/innovative → keyword = vision; if the portrait is meticulous/precise → keyword = craft; if the portrait is bold/decisive → keyword = courage; if the portrait is relaxed/unhurried → keyword = calm; if the portrait is ambitious/aspiring → keyword = drive
Overall style: minimalist, high readability, no extra elements, strict consistency between character features and uploaded photo, perfect fit between light and shadow and character contour
Sampler: DPM++ 2M Karras, steps:25-30, CFG Scale:7-8, denoising strength:0.3, resolution:3840×2160
